cues.text: “Make room for my laptop: clear the space in front of it”
Finds every object on your photo
Writes the edit for this exact photo
Develops 3 versions of the after photo
Checks every object in every version
Picks the version that follows the request
It is the plan you approve before a robot touches anything
Gives each move to a robot that can do it, or says why not
Robots rehearse on SAM 3D bodies; every object is measured
